rubrics.justification: Describes a Day 5 expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive/abundant TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single still image, though some comments are somewhat generic rather than image-specific.

Integrates age, AMH, BMI, unexplained infertility, prior ectopic/miscarriage/live births, sperm motility, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis; a few speculative additions (e.g., endometriosis, APS) are not strongly grounded in the provided case.

Overall logic is sound and the prognosis estimate broadly follows from embryo quality and patient factors, but there are inconsistencies and distracting speculation (fresh vs FET uncertainty, donor eggs mention, recurrent ectopic implication despite only one ectopic listed).

Generally aligned with IVF practice in supporting single embryo transfer and cautious selective workup, but includes some less guideline-grounded suggestions (PGT-A framing, APS testing after a single clinical miscarriage, donor eggs discussion, speculative endometriosis).

Provides practical recommendations for SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, early hCG/ultrasound follow-up after prior ectopic, and selective future workup/cycle planning; useful though some suggestions are broader than necessary for this case.
